# sanity Provider

The Sanity provider allows you to manage resources on the Sanity.io platform using Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    sanity = {
      source  = "valoriz/sanity"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

# Authenticate using the SANITY_TOKEN environment variable (recommended),
# or explicitly configure api_token in the provider block:
provider "sanity" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Sanity API token. Can also be set with the `SANITY_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `api_version` (String) Sanity API version (for example, `v2024-01-01`). Defaults to `v2024-01-01`. Can also be set with `SANITY_API_VERSION`.
